summary_md: **VB ([@techtactician](https://x.com/techtactician/status/2115134544940576934))** summarizes *What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly.*: on SWE-bench with the same models in three harnesses, accuracy stayed within 5 points but cost per task varied up to 3x, largely because the setup prompt is resent every step (16.6K tokens vs ~800).

relevance: Direct evidence that harness prompt design dominates cost.
